name: app-store-compliance
description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A checklist-and-guard system that catches the common reasons Apple and Google reject apps before you submit, so you don't lose days waiting on a rejection.
buyer: An indie mobile app developer or small app agency who has been burned by App Store rejections eating their launch timeline.
business_use_cases: A solo app developer runs it before every submission to catch privacy-manifest and metadata issues automatically.
A mobile dev agency bakes it into their delivery checklist so client apps don't get rejected on the agency's watch.
A startup preparing a big launch date uses the deadline tracker to make sure they submit early enough to survive a rejection-and-resubmit cycle.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'pre-submission compliance review' service for app teams about to launch.
Build a hosted SaaS version that scans an app binary/metadata automatically and charges per scan or per month.

steal_this: Package this as a paid Fiverr/Upwork gig: '$99 pre-submission App Store review' — run the open playbook against a client's app and hand them a fix list.
